Name: SoundMuter
Author: deykfa
Description:
With this mod you can bind key to mute music in game, first pressing keybind is muting music, second unmuting. Purpose of the mod is to quickly mute music if you're tired of listening to the game's music or want to listen to your own (other game sounds are not affected). After installing it you need to bind key in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] in menu or just in game. That's it.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install SoundMuter archive.
Unzip the mod folder into [color=#93c47d][font=Verdana]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font][/color]
Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=4]If you like this mod please endorse it. If you find any bugs, please report them.[/size]
